> [!warning] Website lifecycle date conflict
> The Braintree Get Started website snapshot says Drop-in deprecation starts October 1, 2026, payment processing remains supported until October 1, 2027, and unsupported status begins on October 1, 2027. Those dates differ from the September milestones in the retained `braintree-web-drop-in@1.47.0` repository source. Treat the schedules as source-specific and verify current status before migration planning. [[source-braintree-get-started]]
warnings: Preserve the existing exact-version GitHub dates and present this as a source conflict, not as an overwrite or a reconciled current schedule.

The website notice links an iOS v6 status-category path even though the page discusses Drop-in generally; do not infer that the dates apply identically to every separately versioned Drop-in package without current product-specific verification.
